# Chief Complaint
- Fatigue
- Frequent Urination


# History of Present Illness
Sharan181 is a 74 year-old non-hispanic black female. Patient has a history of streptococcal sore throat (disorder), acute allergic reaction, laceration of hand, concussion with no loss of consciousness, perennial allergic rhinitis with seasonal variation, acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), sprain of wrist, viral sinusitis (disorder), facial laceration, normal pregnancy, acute bronchitis (disorder), blighted ovum, otitis media, anemia (disorder), escherichia coli urinary tract infection, second degree burn.

# Social History
Patient is married. Patient is temporarily homeless. Patient has a documented history of opioid addiction. Patient is an active smoker and is an alcoholic. Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a low socioeconomic background. Patient has a high school education. Patient currently has Medicare.

# Allergies
latex allergy

# Medications
penicillin v potassium 250 mg oral tablet; acetaminophen 325 mg oral tablet; prednisone 5 mg oral tablet; insulin human, isophane 70 unt/ml / regular insulin, human 30 unt/ml injectable suspension [humulin]; hydrocodone bitartrate 5 mg / acetaminophen 300 mg oral tablet; mestranol / norethynodrel [enovid]; aspirin 81 mg oral tablet; hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg oral tablet; oxycodone 5 mg / acetaminophen 325 mg oral tablet; penicillin g 375 mg/ml injectable solution; phenazopyridine hcl 100 mg oral tablet; oxycodone hcl 15 mg 12 hr extended release oral tablet, abuse-deterrent; amoxicillin 250 mg / clavulanate potassium 125 mg oral tablet; nitrofurantoin 25 mg in 5 ml oral suspension

# Assessment and Plan


## Plan
